control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of HT-9001 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9001 and HT-9006 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9001 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 21 January 2015 an incident occurred on HT-9001 and HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
